correctness.rationale: For arbitrary nondegenerate tetrahedron S, affine normalize to conv(0,e1,e2,e3) and compute G_v(a,b) from all 14 facets of aS+b(-S). This yields |S+t[0,v]|=(1+3tT)/6 and |(S+t[0,v])-(S+t[0,v])|=10/3+2t(T+H). The symmetric mixed-volume expansion has coefficient six: |K-K|=2|K|+6V_3(K,K,-K). The exhaustive sign classification for four zero-sum barycentric derivatives gives T<=H<=2T, with precise equality orientations; w=(1,1,-u,-(2-u)) realizes every intermediate H/T for 0<=u<=1. An independent explicit convex-hull verifier passed 486 rational-parameter and geometric-volume comparisons. Finite checks do not replace proof. No claim is made for q=0 except its classical limiting value.
